Regulated twice.
Locked by you.

Touch 'n Go answers to two national regulators, and nothing leaves your account without you confirming it.

The first e-wallet to join the National Scam Response Centre and Bank Negara Malaysia's National Fraud Portal.

Visit the Security Centre →

  • Regulated by BNM and the SC

    Bank Negara Malaysia regulates TNG Digital as an e-money issuer and merchant acquirer. The Securities Commission registers it as a market operator.

  • Funds held in trust

    Your eWallet balance sits in trust accounts at licensed banks that are members of PIDM, and is used only for regulated purposes like paying merchants.

  • One phone, one account

    Your eWallet is tied to your device and unlocked with your face or fingerprint. A new phone gets a cool-down of up to 48 hours.

  • Refunds for what wasn't you

    Report a transaction you didn't make and it's investigated within 14 days. If you didn't authorise it, you're refunded. T&Cs apply.

Help centre → Contact us →
Is my money safe?

Yes. TNG eWallet is regulated by Bank Negara Malaysia and the Securities Commission Malaysia, and your balance is held in trust accounts at PIDM-member banks. If you spot a transaction you didn't make, report it. It's investigated within 14 days, and refunded if it wasn't you (T&Cs apply).

Is the Touch 'n Go card the same as the eWallet?

They're two products from the same family. The Touch 'n Go card (and the Charm) is prepaid, and you tap it at tolls, parking and public transport. TNG eWallet is the app, and it covers RFID tolls, QR payments, transfers, savings and more. Many people use both.

Does my RFID tag need its own balance?

No. Once it's linked, your RFID tag pays tolls straight from your eWallet balance. Keep the app topped up and the lane opens.

How do I add money?

Reload in the app from your online banking or debit card, or at selected reload points and convenience stores.

Does it cost anything?

Downloading the app and registering is free. Fees and limits for each product are set out in its Product Disclosure Sheet and shown in the app before you confirm.

Can my business accept Touch 'n Go eWallet?

Yes. TNG Digital is a licensed merchant acquirer, so shops, stalls and online sellers can sign up to accept TNG eWallet payments directly.
